info.dressCode: Collared shirts or golf mock-collar shirts; women may wear sleeveless golf shirts. No jeans, t-shirts, swimwear, leggings, tracksuits or cut-offs, on the course or the practice area.
info.shoes: Soft spikes are required: metal spikes are not allowed.
info.changingRooms: Changing rooms in the restored original estate building. Free lockers (take a €1 coin), free towels and shower products.
info.parking: Car park at the club, with EV charging points.
info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.
info.flights: The club may pair players into groups of up to four.
info.arrivalNotes: Check in at reception at least 30 minutes before the tee time and be on the 1st tee 10 minutes before. Juniors show ID at check-in.

info.firstTee: The first tee time is usually 08:00.

info.rangeOpens: Range use is free with a green fee. Balls come from a card machine: €5 for 1 credit (about 40 balls), €20 for 5 credits, €35 for 10 and €60 for 20. TrackMan Range with 21 open and 7 covered bays.

info.dressCode: Men: collared or crew-neck shirt tucked into the trousers at all times, golf trousers or shorts, and caps worn with the peak forward. No T-shirts, tank tops, jeans, tracksuits, cargo pants, three-quarter length trousers, sandals or sneakers. Ladies: collared or crew-neck shirt (sleeveless golf shirts are fine) and golf trousers or skirts of a sensible length. No T-shirts, blouses, tank tops, jeans, tracksuits, sandals, sneakers or heels.

foodBeforeRound.winter: The restaurant opens at 08:00 and the kitchen at 09:00, so there is no cooked breakfast before a 09:00 start.

info.bringWater: No need to bring water. Tees and water are provided.
info.proShopOpens: Course and driving range open 08:00-20:00.
info.firstTee: The first tee time is 07:30 from May to September, and around 08:00 in winter.
info.earlyTee: I arrived before the pro shop had opened and waited for reception, then checked in and collected the buggy before teeing off. Allow time for this on an early tee time.
info.rangeOpens: Driving range 08:00-20:00. Range balls are not included: a token of 30 balls costs €5.
info.foodBeforeRound: T-elicious restaurant in the clubhouse. The bar opens at 09:00, so nothing is on offer before an early start.
info.water: Tees and water are provided.
info.licence: €3 per person per day, unless you hold a Spanish federation licence.
info.dressCode: Collared shirts, tailored shorts or trousers and golf shoes. No jeans.
info.shoes: Golf shoes with soft spikes. Metal spikes are not allowed.
info.changingRooms: Changing room with lockers (electronic lockers reset daily) and showers.
info.parking: Easy parking right by the clubhouse.
info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.
info.flights: The club may add other players to a group of fewer than four.
info.arrivalNotes: Official handicap required: 28 men, 34 ladies. Dogs on a lead allowed on the course and terrace.

t_golf_palma.name: T Golf Palma
t_golf_palma.address: Camí Vell de Sineu, Km 10, 07198 Palma

info.bringWater: A water bottle. The halfway house is open 11:00 to 16:00 in peak season, and there is a drinks cart on the course.
info.proShopOpens: Course open 08:00-20:00 in summer, 08:00-18:00 in winter.
info.firstTee: 07:30 was the first tee time of the day when I played.
info.earlyTee: The course opens 08:00 and the restaurant 08:30, yet 07:30 tee times are sold, so an early group has no coffee and may have no range. The first tee time of the day is 07:30.
info.rangeOpens: Driving range 08:00-18:00; on Tuesdays it closes at 16:00. The range, pitching and putting areas are included with a 9 or 18-hole green fee on the same day; otherwise the practice fee is €15 per person. Range balls are not included: a token of 30 balls costs €5 (Wilson Premium balls).
info.foodBeforeRound: Restaurant opens 08:30 (summer 08:30-20:00, winter 08:30-19:00); the kitchen runs 11:00-19:00 in summer, 11:00-17:45 in winter. Nothing is open before 08:30.
info.water: Halfway house open 11:00-16:00 in peak season. From mid-March there is a mandatory 10-minute stop at the halfway. Drinks cart on the course.
info.licence: €3 per person per day, unless you hold a Spanish federation licence.
info.dressCode: Collared shirts, tailored shorts or trousers and golf shoes are required. No jeans.
info.shoes: Golf shoes are required.
info.changingRooms: Locker room with heated floors, air conditioning, showers and lockers.
info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.
info.flights: The club may group players into fourballs. A group can pay for the whole tee time to keep it to themselves, if the booking allows.
info.arrivalNotes: Official handicap required: 28 men, 34 ladies. Dogs on a lead are allowed on the course and terrace. Keep an eye on your belongings, as the club warns of thefts at golf courses on the island.

vall_dor.name: Vall d'Or
vall_dor.address: Ctra Cala d'Or - Portocolom, Km 7,7, 07669 Felanitx

info.bringWater: Your own water. There is no drinkable water on the course, and bottles are sold at the restaurant.
info.hireBags: Hire sets are for use with a buggy or a manual or electric trolley only, not for carrying.
info.proShopOpens: Reception and the pro shop open at 07:30.
info.firstTee: The first tee time is 08:00.
info.rangeOpens: Basket of range balls €4. Practice-only green fee €12.
info.foodBeforeRound: The club tells me everything opens at 07:30, before the 08:00 first tee time. Maxime Restaurant has a terrace with sea and course views, and a Friday barbecue with live music from May to October.
info.water: There is no drinkable water on the course. Bottles are sold at the restaurant, or bring your own.
info.licence: No daily licence charge. A golf licence and handicap are enough.
info.dressCode: Men: shirts with a collar and sleeves. Ladies: a top without a collar needs sleeves, a sleeveless top needs a collar. Tailored trousers or shorts; skirts or shorts for ladies. No denim, tracksuits, cargo, drawstring or gym shorts.
info.shoes: Golf shoes or flat-soled trainers. No street shoes or sandals.
info.changingRooms: Spacious changing rooms with individual showers, towels and lockers.
info.payment: Cards are accepted at the club.
info.flights: The club cannot guarantee that a group of three plays alone, especially in high season. The only way to be sure is to pay for the whole flight.
info.arrivalNotes: The course is open every day of the year.
